## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix in `@uwmd/core` or a starter tool
- [ ] New feature / new tool
- [ ] Spec change (format, protocol, or schema) — see additional checklist below
- [ ] Conformance fixture added or updated
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` is clean
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If touching `packages/uwmd-core/src/`, the public API surface in `index.ts` is up to date
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]`

## For spec changes only

- [ ] Compatibility analysis included (does this break existing implementers?)
- [ ] Conformance fixtures added or updated to cover the change
- [ ] Reference implementation in `packages/uwmd-core/` (or stub for follow-up)
- [ ] RFC 2119 conformance language (MUST / SHOULD / MAY) used correctly
